title: Build the confirmatory freeze authority record and its strict reader (installable, but INSTALL NOTHING)
description:
FILED BY governor-36414416 2026-08-23 20:30Z under decision authority delegated by the human. This row is the SUPERSESSION PATH that governor ruling comment-b308bf89 condition (d) required to exist, and it is the only part of M5's authority gate that is safely delegable.

THE DISTINCTION THIS ROW TURNS ON. Ruling comment-b308bf89 withheld confirmatory freeze authority: no custodian, signer, key, delegated signing, or corpus creation is authorized, and readConfirmatoryFreezeAuthority refuses CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY_UNASSIGNED unconditionally. Two workers have since EXECUTED that reader and confirmed it: {"authority":"NONE","code":"CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY_UNASSIGNED"} at HEAD 2ef3bea.

That ruling stands. This row does NOT lift it.

What this row builds is the MECHANISM by which a human-authorized record could later be read - the durable shape, its strict reader, its validation, and the exact refusal vocabulary for every way the record can be absent or wrong. BUILDING THE ABILITY TO RECORD AUTHORITY IS NOT THE SAME AS GRANTING IT. A governor may commission the former; only a human may perform the latter. That line is why this row is delegable and why installing a custodian is not.

THE HARD PROHIBITION, and it is the whole point of the row: NO ACTUAL AUTHORITY RECORD IS INSTALLED. No custodian is named. No signing key is generated, embedded, referenced, or committed. No registry entry is created. No fixture, demo, test, or default value may stand in as a real custodian. At the end of this row `readConfirmatoryFreezeAuthority` MUST STILL REFUSE on the committed tree, and a test must PROVE it still refuses. If the row ends with anything other than a refusal on committed bytes, it has failed.

WHY THIS UNBLOCKS REAL WORK. Today the human's decision is not a decision - it is a decision plus an unscoped engineering project, which is why it has sat. After this row, installing authority becomes a DATA change against a known shape with a known reader and known refusals: name the custodian, provide the record, done. task-3a34adca (corpus freeze) and task-8af4562f (benchmark campaign) both terminate in that install; task-c127ed41's admission path already fails closed on the same code and layer and must keep doing so.

SCOPE FENCE:
1. Does NOT modify the refusal behaviour of the current unconditional refusal path except to route it through the new reader, and the refusal must remain unconditional while no record exists.
2. Does NOT touch task-c127ed41's freeze-manifest admission - that row is WORKING and owns it. Compose, never duplicate.
3. Does NOT decide WHO the custodian should be, what key material is acceptable, or what signing algorithm is correct as a product matter. If the shape cannot be defined without making that call, BLOCK and name the exact decision.
4. Preserves CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY_UNASSIGNED at CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY as the code and layer for the no-record case. That code is load-bearing durable evidence that the withholding was a decision, not a forgotten feature.

REQUIRED READING BEFORE PLANNING: ruling comment-b308bf89 (the four binding conditions), and the committed header at packages/benchmark/src/confirmatory-freeze-authority.ts:25-26 which already states why the code and layer are not cosmetic. task-22b69ee5 is the reference implementation of a withholding done correctly.

IF THE SHAPE CANNOT BE BUILT WITHOUT NAMING A CUSTODIAN OR CHOOSING KEY MATERIAL: file the prerequisite and BLOCK. Do not default one. That is the human's call and it is the one thing this row exists to make cheap rather than to make for them.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK FIRST: at the delivered tree, execute readConfirmatoryFreezeAuthority() through the committed .js bridge and record its raw return in a durable task comment, alongside the current refusal code and layer constants and their exported call sites. Establish the baseline you must still satisfy at the end.

A durable, source-controlled authority record SHAPE is defined with strict validation: the custodian identity, the key or signing material reference, the scope it covers, and any expiry or revocation field the shape needs. The shape is defined in contracts with no IO and no corpus access.

A strict reader consumes that shape from a durable source and returns either a validated authority or a stable coded refusal. Every failure mode has its own code and layer and refuses CLOSED: record missing, malformed, unreadable, stale, expired, revoked, foreign-scope, and conflicting-duplicate at minimum. Each code is asserted by name in a focused test.

NO AUTHORITY IS INSTALLED. No custodian named, no key generated or committed, no registry entry created, and no fixture, demo, test, or default value able to present itself as a real custodian on the production path. A grep over the diff demonstrates this.

REGRESSION PROOF, and this row fails without it: on the committed tree at the end of this row, readConfirmatoryFreezeAuthority STILL returns CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY_UNASSIGNED at CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY, and a named test asserts exactly that code and layer. A mutation drill swapping the code reds that named assertion - an assertion that only checks 'it refuses' passes against any refusal and certifies nothing.

The refusal site documents the install procedure: what a human must provide to supersede the withholding, citing ruling comment-b308bf89 by id, so a later reader finds it from the code rather than from a plan.

task-c127ed41's freeze-manifest admission is composed, not duplicated, and continues to fail closed on the same code and layer. pnpm --filter @moe/benchmark typecheck and test are each run as SEPARATE unpiped legs, both exit 0 with nonzero counts, and pnpm test:security is run because it is an orphan gate that no other suite covers and this row mints exported constants.
taskRails: The withholding ruling comment-b308bf89 STANDS. This row builds the ability to record authority; it does not grant any. Ending with anything other than a refusal on committed bytes is a failure.
Never install a custodian, generate or commit key material, or let a fixture/demo/default present itself as real authority on the production path.
Do not decide WHO the custodian is, what key material is acceptable, or which signing algorithm is correct. If the shape cannot be defined without that call, BLOCK and name it.
Preserve CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY_UNASSIGNED at CONFIRMATORY_FREEZE_AUTHORITY for the no-record case - that code is durable evidence the withholding was a decision, not a forgotten feature.
Compose task-c127ed41's admission path, never duplicate it. That row is WORKING and owns it.
Mint no exported boundary constant without also planning its security roster row AND the BEFORE/AFTER/RACE completeness arms - a roster row alone relocates the red into completeness.security.ts.

EVERY refusal carries `authority: "NONE"` — integrity-boundaries.security.ts:74 reads any other string as ADMITTED. Keep the file under 250 lines.
